name: The Isle: Evrima (Windows / feathers)
author: admin@primalhosted.com
description: The Isle EVRIMA dedicated server (app 412680 -beta evrima). Renders Game.ini every boot from egg variables incl. full gameplay knobs (day/night, growth, weather, AI, mutations, diets…) + admin/VIP Steam IDs + allowed-dino toggles.

# Primal - The Isle: Evrima install script (egg 40, feathers / native-Windows node).
#
# ASCII ONLY. Same constraint as start-evrima.ps1: PowerShell 5.1 on the feathers
# node decodes this as CP1252, and several multi-byte characters decode to byte
# 0x94 which PS treats as a quote - enough of them and the script stops parsing.
# See README.md "ASCII ONLY" and BUGS #448.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = (Get-Location).Path
$game = Join-Path $root 'server'
$sc   = Join-Path $root 'steamcmd'
$prim = Join-Path $root '_primal'
foreach ($d in $game, $sc, $prim) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT "INSTALLED" MEANS HERE  (BUGS #346 - the customer-#3 onboarding gate)
#
# On 2026-07-28 this script printed 'Install complete.' and exited 0 after all
# five steamcmd attempts failed at connect with no game files on disk. A paying
# customer got a permanently unbootable server that REPORTED SUCCESS. Three
# separate defects produced that, and all three are fixed below:
#
#   1) There was no failing exit path at all. The missing-exe branch logged
#      'WARNING: TheIsleServer.exe NOT found' - it already knew the terminal
#      state - and then fell through to 'Install complete.' and exit 0.
#
#   2) It tested the WRONG FILE. server\TheIsleServer.exe is a 0.23 MB thin
#      launcher. start-evrima.ps1 does NOT launch it (see its LAUNCH block:
#      "Launch the REAL Shipping binary directly, NOT the 0.23MB root
#      TheIsleServer.exe thin launcher") - it launches
#      server\TheIsle\Binaries\Win64\TheIsleServer-Win64-Shipping.exe and
#      throws without it. Measured on live server 93da0534 on 2026-07-30:
#      242,176 B vs 185,213,952 B, a 765x difference.
#
#   3) The retry loop broke on that same wrong file. The thin launcher lands in
#      the first seconds of a ~70 GB pull, so the loop stopped retrying while
#      the install had barely started - the retries were spent, not used.
#
# So: the gate is the binary the WRAPPER launches, checked from the consumer's
# own path, and a failure exits 1 with a CLASS that says what to do about it.
# Only Complete-Install prints a success line. Nothing infers success from the
# absence of an exception - steamcmd is a native exe whose non-zero exit does
# NOT throw under $ErrorActionPreference='Stop', which is why this went unseen.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# The thin launcher. Diagnostic value only - never a success criterion.
$launcherExe = Join-Path $game 'TheIsleServer.exe'
# THE gate: the binary start-evrima.ps1 launches and throws without.
$serverExe   = Join-Path $game 'TheIsle\Binaries\Win64\TheIsleServer-Win64-Shipping.exe'

$steamExits = @()

function Test-Tcp {
    # Dependency-free reachability probe. Deliberately NOT Test-NetConnection:
    # that lives in the NetTCPIP module, which is not guaranteed present in the
    # stock windows/steamcmd image, and a diagnostic that itself fails to run
    # would turn a clear failure back into a vague one.
    param([string]$Target, [int]$Port = 443, [int]$TimeoutMs = 6000)
    $client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient
    try {
        $iar = $client.BeginConnect($Target, $Port, $null, $null)
        if (-not $iar.AsyncWaitHandle.WaitOne($TimeoutMs, $false)) { return $false }
        $client.EndConnect($iar)
        return $true
    } catch {
        return $false
    } finally {
        $client.Close()
    }
}

function Test-Dns {
    param([string]$Target)
    try { [System.Net.Dns]::GetHostAddresses($Target) | Out-Null; return $true }
    catch { return $false }
}

function Get-FreeGb {
    # Returns -1 for "could not measure". A class is never assigned from -1:
    # an unmeasurable disk must not be reported as a full one.
    param([string]$PathOnDisk)
    try {
        $qual = Split-Path -Qualifier ((Resolve-Path $PathOnDisk).Path)
        $drive = Get-PSDrive -Name $qual.TrimEnd(':') -ErrorAction Stop
        if ($null -eq $drive.Free) { return -1 }
        return [math]::Round($drive.Free / 1GB, 1)
    } catch { return -1 }
}

function Fail-Install {
    param(
        [string]   $Class,
        [string]   $Summary,
        [string[]] $Detail = @(),
        [string[]] $Next   = @()
    )
    Write-Output ''
    Write-Output '================================================================'
    Write-Output ('INSTALL FAILED [' + $Class + ']')
    Write-Output '================================================================'
    Write-Output $Summary
    if ($Detail.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Output ''
        Write-Output 'Evidence:'
        foreach ($line in $Detail) { Write-Output ('  ' + $line) }
    }
    if ($Next.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Output ''
        Write-Output 'What to do:'
        foreach ($line in $Next) { Write-Output ('  - ' + $line) }
    }
    Write-Output ''
    Write-Output 'This install did NOT complete. There is no bootable server binary.'
    Write-Output 'Exiting 1 so the panel marks the install FAILED instead of ready.'
    Write-Output '================================================================'
    exit 1
}

Write-Output 'Downloading SteamCMD...'
$zip = Join-Path $sc 'steamcmd.zip'
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd.zip' -OutFile $zip
Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $sc -Force
$steam = Join-Path $sc 'steamcmd.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path $steam)) {
    Fail-Install -Class 'STEAMCMD-MISSING' `
        -Summary 'steamcmd.zip downloaded and extracted, but steamcmd.exe is not there.' `
        -Detail @("expected: $steam") `
        -Next @('Valve changed the zip layout, or the extract was blocked. Reinstall to retry.')
}

Write-Output 'Bootstrapping SteamCMD (self-update)...'
& $steam +quit
$bootstrapExit = $LASTEXITCODE
Write-Output ("(steamcmd) bootstrap exit code: " + $bootstrapExit)

# The Isle's first app_update reliably fails with "Missing configuration" (Steam
# app-config not cached yet). Retry until the SHIPPING binary appears - this is
# why the classic crash-loop .bat runs app_update repeatedly.
$maxTries = 5
for ($i = 1; $i -le $maxTries; $i++) {
    Write-Output "Installing The Isle: Evrima (app 412680, evrima) - attempt $i/$maxTries (~70GB)..."
    & $steam +force_install_dir $game +login anonymous +app_update 412680 -beta evrima validate +quit
    $steamExits += $LASTEXITCODE
    Write-Output ("(steamcmd) attempt $i exit code: " + $LASTEXITCODE)

    if (Test-Path $serverExe) {
        Write-Output 'The Isle server files present (Shipping binary found).'
        break
    }

    # First miss is usually "Steam config warming up" (transient) - a plain retry
    # fixes it. From attempt 2 on, nuke steamapps to self-heal a corrupt
    # appmanifest/downloading (the 2026-07-09 Evrima update outage) that would
    # otherwise wedge every retry.
    if ($i -ge 2) {
        # ...but ONLY if Steam is actually reachable. In the #346 incident every
        # attempt failed at CONNECT, and this self-heal deleted the 4.4 GB
        # partial each time, so the same bytes were re-fetched five times for
        # nothing. A partial download is only suspect when the pull could
        # actually reach Steam; when it could not, the partial is fine and
        # deleting it is pure wasted egress.
        if (Test-Tcp -Target 'steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net') {
            Write-Output '(self-heal) still missing after retry - deleting steamapps for a clean re-fetch...'
            $steamApps = Join-Path $game 'steamapps'
            if (Test-Path $steamApps) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $steamApps -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
        } else {
            Write-Output '(self-heal) SKIPPED: Steam is unreachable from this box right now, so the'
            Write-Output '(self-heal) partial download is not corrupt - keeping steamapps rather than'
            Write-Output '(self-heal) re-fetching the same bytes on a dead link. See BUGS #346.'
        }
    } else {
        Write-Output 'app not installed yet (Steam config warming up); retrying in 10s...'
    }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 10
}

$prereq = Join-Path $game 'Engine\Extras\Redist\en-us\UE4PrereqSetup_x64.exe'
if (Test-Path $prereq) {
    Write-Output 'Installing UE4 prerequisites (VC++ redistributables)...'
    Start-Process -FilePath $prereq -ArgumentList '/quiet','/norestart' -Wait
} else {
    # Not fatal on its own, but it is a strong signal the pull is incomplete, and
    # it must not pass silently: the terminal gate below is what decides.
    Write-Output '(prereq) UE4PrereqSetup_x64.exe not present - the game pull is incomplete.'
}

Write-Output 'Writing Primal helper files (config templates + startup wrapper)...'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $prim 'Engine.ini.tmpl'),  [Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $prim 'Game.ini.tmpl'),    [Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $prim 'start-evrima.ps1'), [Convert]::FromBase64String(''))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TERMINAL GATE. Nothing below infers success from "nothing threw".
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Output ''
Write-Output '--- Verifying the install against what start-evrima.ps1 actually launches ---'

$launcherOk   = Test-Path $launcherExe
$serverOk     = Test-Path $serverExe
$launcherSize = if ($launcherOk) { (Get-Item $launcherExe).Length } else { 0 }
$serverSize   = if ($serverOk)   { (Get-Item $serverExe).Length }   else { 0 }

Write-Output ('  thin launcher (NOT the gate)  server\TheIsleServer.exe : ' + $(if ($launcherOk) { "present, $launcherSize B" } else { 'MISSING' }))
Write-Output ('  THE GATE  server\TheIsle\Binaries\Win64\TheIsleServer-Win64-Shipping.exe : ' + $(if ($serverOk) { "present, $serverSize B" } else { 'MISSING' }))

if ($serverOk -and $serverSize -gt 0) {
    Write-Output ''
    Write-Output ('OK: TheIsleServer-Win64-Shipping.exe present (' + $serverSize + ' B).')
    Write-Output 'Install complete.'
    exit 0
}

# --- the install produced no bootable server: diagnose, then exit 1 ----------
$freeGb    = Get-FreeGb $root
$dnsOk     = Test-Dns  'api.steampowered.com'
$genericOk = Test-Tcp  -Target '1.1.1.1'
$steamApi  = Test-Tcp  -Target 'api.steampowered.com'
$steamCdn  = Test-Tcp  -Target 'steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net'

$evidence = @(
    ('steamcmd bootstrap exit : ' + $bootstrapExit),
    ('steamcmd attempt exits  : ' + $(if ($steamExits.Count -gt 0) { ($steamExits -join ', ') } else { '(never ran)' })),
    ('attempts made           : ' + $steamExits.Count + ' of ' + $maxTries),
    ('thin launcher present   : ' + $launcherOk + ' (' + $launcherSize + ' B)'),
    ('shipping binary present : ' + $serverOk + ' (' + $serverSize + ' B)'),
    ('free disk on volume     : ' + $(if ($freeGb -lt 0) { 'could not measure' } else { "$freeGb GB" })),
    ('DNS api.steampowered.com: ' + $dnsOk),
    ('TCP 1.1.1.1:443         : ' + $genericOk + '  (generic outbound)'),
    ('TCP api.steampowered.com: ' + $steamApi),
    ('TCP steamcdn-a...net:443: ' + $steamCdn)
)

if ($serverOk -and $serverSize -eq 0) {
    Fail-Install -Class 'TRUNCATED-BINARY' `
        -Summary 'The Shipping binary exists but is zero bytes, so the server cannot boot.' `
        -Detail $evidence `
        -Next @('Reinstall (admin: Toggle Install Status, then Reinstall) to re-pull it.')
}

if (-not $genericOk -and -not $steamApi -and -not $steamCdn) {
    Fail-Install -Class 'NO-OUTBOUND' `
        -Summary ('This box has NO outbound connectivity - not even to 1.1.1.1. steamcmd ' +
                  'could not have downloaded anything. This is the exact shape of the ' +
                  '2026-07-28 incident (BUGS #346/#347).') `
        -Detail $evidence `
        -Next @(
            'Check the host provider DDoS mitigation FIRST. On 2026-07-28 ReliableSite',
            '  false-positived on steamcmd pulling and cut the box outbound; Ice had it',
            '  disabled on the box. That produced BOTH the failed pull and the dead',
            '  install-notify that wedged the panel on "installing" (#347).',
            'Because outbound is down, feathers may ALSO fail to notify the panel that',
            '  this install finished. If the panel stays stuck on "installing", the live',
            '  recovery is admin: Toggle Install Status, then Reinstall.',
            'Restore connectivity, then Reinstall.'
        )
}

if (-not $dnsOk -and $genericOk) {
    Fail-Install -Class 'DNS-BROKEN' `
        -Summary 'Raw outbound works but Steam hostnames do not resolve, so steamcmd cannot find Steam.' `
        -Detail $evidence `
        -Next @('Fix the container/node DNS resolver, then Reinstall.')
}

if ($genericOk -and -not $steamApi -and -not $steamCdn) {
    Fail-Install -Class 'STEAM-UNREACHABLE' `
        -Summary ('General outbound works, but Steam specifically is unreachable from this box. ' +
                  'Either Steam is down or something on the path is blocking it.') `
        -Detail $evidence `
        -Next @(
            'Check https://steamstat.us for a Steam-side outage.',
            'If Steam is up, suspect firewall/DDoS filtering on the Steam ranges.',
            'Reinstall once Steam is reachable.'
        )
}

if ($freeGb -ge 0 -and $freeGb -lt 10) {
    Fail-Install -Class 'DISK-FULL' `
        -Summary ('Only ' + $freeGb + ' GB free. The Evrima install needs roughly 70 GB and ran out of room.') `
        -Detail $evidence `
        -Next @('Free space on the node or move this server to a bigger volume, then Reinstall.')
}

if (-not $launcherOk) {
    Fail-Install -Class 'STEAMCMD-FAILED' `
        -Summary ('Steam is reachable but steamcmd produced no game files at all - not even the ' +
                  'thin launcher. All ' + $maxTries + ' attempts failed.') `
        -Detail $evidence `
        -Next @(
            'Read the steamcmd exit codes above and the attempt output for the real error.',
            'A "Missing configuration" or "No subscription" run means app 412680 -beta evrima',
            '  refused anonymous login - verify the branch still exists.',
            'Then Reinstall.'
        )
}

# The launcher landed but the 177 MB Shipping binary did not. This is the state
# that used to be reported as a completed install.
Fail-Install -Class 'INCOMPLETE-PULL' `
    -Summary ('The 0.23 MB thin launcher downloaded, but the Shipping binary that actually ' +
              'boots the server did not. The pull started and then stopped partway. ' +
              'THIS is the state the old script called "Install complete."') `
    -Detail $evidence `
    -Next @(
        'Reinstall (admin: Toggle Install Status, then Reinstall) for a clean re-pull.',
        'If it stops at the same place twice, the node ran out of disk or the pull is',
        '  being throttled/interrupted - check the evidence lines above before retrying.'
    )

variables.name: Primal Comm-ban DLL
variables.description: OPS ONLY (BACKLOG A38, DECISIONS 2026-09-17 R5). 1 = place + inject the isolated comm-ban DLL (sha-pinned from R2 primal-commban/latest.json) after the world is up. Empty/0 = off (default). Evrima only. Independent of ENABLE_PRIMAL_MOD. The OWNER's on/off is the panel's comm-ban card; this only decides whether the binary is on the box.

variables.name: Primal Mod Manifest
variables.description: Primal Mod Manifest (rendered into Game.ini each boot).

variables.name: Force-Enable Species
variables.description: Comma-separated non-default playable species to force-enable (e.g. Oviraptor,Baryonyx). Empty = off. NEVER add Compsognathus or Pterodactylus (client crash + character brick).

variables.name: AI Max Count
variables.description: Global AI population ceiling for the Primal pak mod (ONE server-wide cap, not per-species). Written to Engine.ini as AIMaxCount. Default 40 = pak baked default. Takes effect on the next restart.

variables.name: Species Player Caps
variables.description: Per-species player caps for the Primal pak mod, one comma-separated string e.g. Tyrannosaurus:2,Deinosuchus:3. Blank = no caps. Written to Engine.ini as SpeciesCapList. Takes effect on the next restart.

variables.name: Species Cap Interval (s)
variables.description: How often (seconds) the per-species cap check ticks. Only matters when Species Player Caps is set. Written to Engine.ini as SpeciesCapEvery.

variables.name: AI Learning Uploads
variables.description: Master switch for The Isle AI-learning uploads. OFF unless BOTH endpoint URLs are set. Ops-only.

variables.name: AI Learning Upload URL
variables.description: Our capture worker upload endpoint. Carries a live token in the path - set PER SERVER in the panel, NEVER a default in this PUBLIC repo (#1064).

variables.name: AI Learning Manifest URL
variables.description: Our capture worker manifest endpoint. Same token rule as the upload URL.
